meta.description: SteamVR native driver + Python GUI for treadmill locomotion using optical mouse sensors

language_stack.python: 3.10+ (PyQt6, evdev, stdlib only — no pip strava client)
language_stack.c++: C++17, OpenVR/SteamVR driver API, cmake build

meta.last_ui_handoff: Full architectural refactor: 7-phase modularization per AGENTS.md rules

architecture.overview: A Python application reads raw mouse movement from a treadmill-mounted optical mouse via evdev. The movement data is smoothed, curved, and sent to one of two output backends: a Linux uinput gamepad (for non-VR games), or a UDP socket to a native C++ SteamVR driver (for VR games). Health metrics (distance, speed, calories) are computed from DPI-based distance and MET formulas, with optional Strava upload.

layers.gui: Pages and widgets — display data and emit signals only. No business logic.
layers.controllers: Coordinate workflows — no calculations. Injected with dependencies.
layers.services: Pure business logic — movement math, session lifecycle. Testable without Qt.
layers.repositories: JSON I/O layer — ready for extraction from profiles.py.
layers.drivers: Backends (uinput, SteamVR UDP, HIDMaestro) + C++ SteamVR driver.

architecture.dependency_rule: Dependencies point downward only. GUI → Controllers → Services → Repositories → Drivers. No circular imports. No UI imports in business logic. No business logic in QThreads.

project_structure.app/bootstrap.py: Composition root. Constructs all objects with dependency injection. MainWindow receives already-constructed controllers and services. All wiring happens here. Follows AGENTS.md: construction belongs in one place.
project_structure.app/main.py: Entry point. Calls build_app() from bootstrap, loads QSS stylesheet, runs Qt event loop.
project_structure.app/controllers/navigation_controller.py: Tab switching logic (77 lines). Handles Dashboard/Calibration/Profiles/Stats tab cycling, settings overlay toggle, keyboard shortcuts (Q/E, left/right, 1-4, Escape, Backspace, Ctrl), Ctrl-key press detection.
project_structure.app/controllers/profile_controller.py: Profile CRUD and UI sync (303 lines). Loads/saves profiles to JSON, syncs widget state to profile dict and vice versa, creates/deletes/duplicates profiles, manages DPI preset and stride helpers, emits toasts on profile switch.
project_structure.app/services/movement_processor.py: Pure movement math (85 lines). Extracted from TreadmillWorker. Processes raw mouse motion into joystick output via smoothing, deadzone, curve application, sprint detection, sensitivity scaling. Testable without Qt, evdev, or threading.
project_structure.app/services/session_service.py: Session lifecycle coordinator (46 lines). Builds session records from timing/telemetry data, detects walk vs run activity type, computes average speed. Testable without Qt.
project_structure.app/models/session.py: Session dataclass with from_dict/to_dict serialization plus build_session_from_telemetry() pure factory function.
project_structure.app/repositories/__init__.py: Repository directory — ready for JSON I/O extraction from app/core/profiles.py.
project_structure.app/core/constants.py: All magic numbers extracted from across the codebase: stride multiplier, speed thresholds, network ports, DPI presets, CUSTOM_DPI_VALUE, calibration defaults, session/clock timer intervals, thread timeout, sensitivity slider range.
project_structure.app/core/logging.py: Logging service. get_logger() returns a configured logger (DEBUG to stderr). Replaces scattered print() calls per AGENTS.md rules.
project_structure.app/gui/pages/dashboard_page.py: Dashboard tab (159 lines). Treadmill visual, session controls (Start/Stop), live telemetry readouts (speed, distance, calories, duration), status cards (sensor, joystick, SteamVR, Strava), sensitivity slider.
project_structure.app/gui/pages/calibration_page.py: Calibration tab (76 lines). Auto calibrate button, reset health button, live noise/max noise/samples readout.
project_structure.app/gui/pages/profiles_page.py: Profiles tab (76 lines). Profile combo selector, New/Dup/Del buttons, profile tile grid, empty state.
project_structure.app/gui/pages/stats_page.py: Stats tab (143 lines). Session history chart, total stats cards, session list rows, Strava upload/authorize buttons, empty state.
project_structure.app/gui/pages/settings_page.py: Settings overlay (394 lines). Sidebar menu + stacked sub-pages: System, Input Device, Movement, Sprint, Body & Sensor, SteamVR, Strava, Developer Diagnostics. Save button wired via bootstrap injection.
project_structure.app/gui/main_window.py: Main window shell and widget factory (1024 lines, down from 1295). Creates all shared widgets, builds header/footer shell, delegates page construction to page classes, wires signals. Receives controllers via dependency injection from bootstrap.
project_structure.app/backends/base.py: Abstract MovementBackend class. Defines start(), send_movement(), stop().
project_structure.app/backends/uinput_backend.py: UInput gamepad backend. Creates a /dev/uinput virtual Xbox-style gamepad with ABS_X/Y for joystick, EV_KEY for sprint button mapping.
project_structure.app/backends/steamvr_client.py: Python UDP sender. Sends JSON {'move_x', 'move_y', 'sprint', 'speed'} to 127.0.0.1:9001 for the C++ SteamVR driver.
project_structure.app/backends/factory.py: Backend factory. create_backend('uinput') returns UInputBackend, create_backend('steamvr') returns SteamVRClient.
project_structure.app/backends/hidmaestro_backend.py: Stub HIDMaestro backend for future Windows port.
project_structure.app/core/calibration.py: Auto-calibration: reads raw mouse events for 4 seconds, computes deadzone and max_raw_speed from statistical distribution. Emits noise samples for live GUI readout.
project_structure.app/core/curve.py: Response curve logic. Takes normalized input (0.0-1.0) through editable spline points and applies the curve. Supports multi-point editing.
project_structure.app/core/device_scan.py: Scans /dev/input/* for pointer devices using evdev, returns list of {label, path} for the GUI dropdown.
project_structure.app/core/health.py: HealthTracker class. Computes distance from mouse DPI + raw counts + configurable distance_calibration multiplier, speed in km/h from dt, MET-based calories with incline/friction multiplier, steps from height-derived stride length. Incline can be degrees (tan conversion) or legacy percentage grade.
project_structure.app/core/profiles.py: Profile persistence and default values. Stores all config (axis, invert, deadzone, health, strava tokens, distance_calibration, incline_degrees) in app/profiles.json.
project_structure.app/core/treadmill_reader.py: TreadmillWorker QThread (121 lines, down from 182). Reads mouse events in a loop, delegates movement math to MovementProcessor, sends processed movement to backend via send_movement(), emits telemetry signals to GUI. Pure threading — no business logic.
project_structure.app/core/driver_install.py: SteamVR driver install/uninstall helper. Runs cmake configure/build/install, or removes drivers/maratron/.
project_structure.app/core/strava_client.py: Strava OAuth2 + activity upload client. Pure stdlib: no external deps. Handles auth URL, code exchange, token refresh, activity POST.
project_structure.app/gui/curve_widget.py: Interactive curve editor widget (QPainter-based). Left-click to add point, drag to move, right-click to delete.
project_structure.app/gui/style.qss: Steam Big Picture/Input-inspired Qt stylesheet. Dark palette, keyboard-only header, Q/E keycaps, centered nav_pill tabs, minimal active/inactive status dot using Steam-adjacent blue/slate colors, rectangular profile avatar with integrated blue right border, footer pills, command cards, stat tiles, menu sidebar, scrollbar.
project_structure.app/gui/treadmill_widget.py: Code-drawn animated treadmill visual using QPainter and QTimer. Draws a dark treadmill deck with moving belt stripes whose animation speed follows live telemetry speed.
project_structure.app/gui/toast.py: Toast notification widget for transient messages (e.g., 'Switched to Alyx').
project_structure.app/gui/stats_chart_widget.py: Session history chart widget with metric toggle (distance/calories/speed).
project_structure.backends/native-steamvr/: Native C++ SteamVR driver source. Builds to driver_maratron.so.
project_structure.backends/native-steamvr/driver_main.cpp: HmdDriverFactory entry point. Returns MaratronServer and WatchdogServer.
Server provider. Creates UDP receiver on port 9001, registers MaratronDevice with SteamVR.
ITrackedDeviceServerDriver implementation. Exposes joystick_left/x, joystick_left/y, grip/click, trigger, haptic. RunFrame reads from UDP receiver and pushes to SteamVR.
project_structure.backends/native-steamvr/udp_receiver.cpp: UDP receiver thread. Listens on port 9001, parses JSON, exposes move_x(), move_y(), sprint() atomics.
project_structure.backends/native-steamvr/watchdog.cpp/h: Minimal no-op watchdog. init returns success, no background thread.
project_structure.backends/native-steamvr/resources/input/: Input profile for SteamVR binding UI. Defines joystick, grip, trigger, haptic input sources.
Binding profile emulating vive_controller for backwards compatibility. (Can be renamed/cleaned up later.)

change_log.summary: Decomposed the 1295-line MainWindow god class and 182-line TreadmillWorker into 21 new files across controllers, services, models, repositories, pages, and bootstrap layers. All business logic extracted from Qt widgets. Dependency injection via composition root. AGENTS.md rules enforced: no silent exceptions, no magic numbers, logging service, downward-only dependencies.
details: Phase 1: Extracted 5 UI pages from MainWindow — DashboardPage, CalibrationPage, ProfilesPage, StatsPage, SettingsPage.
Phase 2: Extracted NavigationController (tab switching, keyboard shortcuts) and ProfileController (profile CRUD, UI sync, DPI/stride helpers) with dependency injection via callbacks.
Phase 3: Extracted MovementProcessor (pure motion math from TreadmillWorker — now testable without Qt/evdev/threading) and SessionService (session finalization logic).
Phase 4: Created app/repositories/ directory — ready for JSON I/O extraction from profiles.py.
Phase 5: Created Session dataclass in app/models/ with from_dict/to_dict + build_session_from_telemetry() factory.

Phase 6: Fixed violations — extracted all magic numbers to constants.py, added logging service, replaced silent except: pass with _log.exception(), removed unused imports, eliminated duplicate method definitions.
Phase 7: Created bootstrap.py composition root — all objects constructed with dependency injection, controllers + pages wired after construction, signal wiring deferred to post-injection.
Bug fixes: CUSTOM_DPI_VALUE missing from constants, save_callback NoneType crash, SettingsPage sys_save_button None connect, _wire_signals/_finalize_init called before controller injection.
Removed duplicate refresh_devices definitions (2 copies in original file).
Removed 13 methods from MainWindow delegated to ProfileController.
Removed 6 unused imports (copy, DEFAULT_PROFILE, ConfirmModal, _set_combo_data, DPI/stride helpers).
App launches clean: python -m app runs without errors or warnings.
design_decisions: Only phases strictly outlined in AGENTS.md were executed — no feature creep, no style changes.
bootstrap.py calls _wire_signals() and _finalize_init() after injection rather than in __init__ to avoid NoneType crashes on self.profile_ctrl.
save_callback for SettingsPage starts as None and is wired by bootstrap after ProfileController construction.
TreadmillWorker delegates all math to MovementProcessor — QThread only handles evdev I/O and signal emission.
SessionService.finalize() returns (session_dict, summary, strava_summary) as a 3-tuple or None for guard clause compatibility.
hasattr(self, 'profile_ctrl') guard was broken (returns True for None) — replaced with save_callback=None + post-injection wiring.
validation: python -m py_compile on all 21 new files plus modified files — all pass clean.
python -m app launches the GUI with no tracebacks, no AttributeErrors, no ImportErrors.
Full import chain verified: __main__ → main → build_app → MainWindow → all pages, controllers, services, models.

change_log.summary: Converted the app header into a Steam Input / Big Picture inspired keyboard-only header and iteratively polished layout, profile display, status indicator, and avatar styling.
details: Replaced the plain centered Dashboard/Calibration/Profiles/Stats tab bar with a two-row Steam-like header shell.
Removed controller-style L1/R1 prompts and all verbose navigation hint text.
Added keyboard-only Q/E keycaps pinned to far left and far right of the nav row, with centered uppercase tab pills.
Added Q and E shortcuts for previous/next tab cycling; retained left/right arrows and 1-4 direct tab shortcuts as convenience controls.
Changed top-left title from MaratronVR Keyboard Settings to dynamic Profile: {current profile}.
Added update_profile_header() to keep profile title and avatar initial synced with active profile selection.
Added a placeholder profile avatar for future Strava profile-picture matching; current avatar is a rectangular badge with integrated Steam-blue right border.
Added a centered active/inactive session status indicator as a minimal dot instead of text; uses Steam-adjacent active blue and inactive slate colors.
Wired status dot updates to session lifecycle: start() marks active, stop() marks inactive.
Moved right-side header composition to time then profile avatar.
Adjusted profile/time typography to match the dashboard style more closely and then bolded both per feedback.
Validated Python syntax repeatedly with python -m py_compile app/gui/main_window.py after code changes.
design_decisions: Keep the header purely keyboard-oriented rather than controller-oriented.
Use Q/E as keyboard equivalents of Steam shoulder navigation, visually placed at the outer nav edges.
Use a dot for activity state because it is less visually noisy than ACTIVE/INACTIVE text.
Keep Strava profile-picture functionality dormant-safe: provide UI placeholder now, defer network/API athlete profile fetch until later.
Use Steam-like blues/slates for active/inactive state instead of green/gray to harmonize with the existing dark blue UI.
validation: python -m py_compile app/gui/main_window.py completed successfully after implementation passes.
follow_up: If exact Steam font matching is desired, investigate available local fonts and tune font-family/weight/letter-spacing in style.qss.
When Strava integration is reactivated, add athlete profile fetch and replace avatar initial with downloaded/cached Strava profile image.
